items.t: Relief that nobody is naming. The thing that might have gone wrong did not.
Low grade mutiny. Two of them have decided something and have not told the third.
Tenderness caught by accident, and immediately covered up with a joke.
The specific tiredness of having been kind all day.
Anticipation. Coats on, door not open yet, everyone slightly too pleased.
Genuine offence at something completely trivial.
Solidarity in a bad situation. Nobody is enjoying it and nobody is leaving.
Pride in somebody else, expressed by insulting them.
The lull after laughing. Everyone still smiling at nothing in particular.
Wary optimism. It is going well, which is suspicious.
Being humoured, and knowing it, and allowing it.
Comfortable silence broken by one person deciding to speak. Nobody wants them to.
A slow realisation moving across the room one face at a time.
Nostalgia for something that happened last week.
Stubbornness meeting stubbornness at low volume.
Being welcomed back into a room. Nothing said, space made.
Doting on {4} to an unreasonable degree.
Mild betrayal over food.
The specific brightness of a good day that everyone knows will not last.
Nervous energy with no outlet. Somebody is bouncing a leg.
Fondness expressed entirely through insult and understood perfectly.
Shared embarrassment about something that happened in public.
Determination without a plan.
Reluctant admiration.
The quiet of somebody being allowed to not talk.
Everyone tired in a different way from everyone else.
Suppressed laughter in a situation that does not allow it.
Small ceremony. Something ordinary being treated as an occasion on purpose.
Being talked out of something, badly, and going along with it.
Contentment that is slightly smug about being contentment.
The moment of deciding to go home.
Loyalty being demonstrated without anyone acknowledging it.
